page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, delivering 128 vCPUs. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, and the configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance specifically for workloads reliant on high memory capacity and network throughput rather than local disk I/O or parallel graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its dedicated CPU resources, making it suitable for enterprise-scale deployments that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
